task_title: Fix tokenizer cache corruption under concurrent access
summary: Fundamentally misunderstood the task. Instead of fixing the cache write/read path, the agent 'fixed' the concurrent access problem by adding a global threading.Lock around the entire tokenize() call — which doesn't address file-level corruption at all and introduces a bottleneck. The code compiles and 2 trivially-passing tests pass, but the core atomicity and validation requirements are unmet. Code is a mix of inline lock acquisitions and commented-out attempts.
